verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop terminal app, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage tracking, nor any switch to turn them off. The separately installed AI plugin, the opt-in AI key field and the Internet-Free Install option for shell integration are adjacent network-privacy controls, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
